component.name: Apparat
component.summary: Offline PDF, video, image and utility tools

description.p: 21 everyday tools that work entirely on your computer, with no account and no uploads.

ul.li: PDF: remove password, compress, split, merge, PDF to images, photos to PDF
Video and audio: shrink, trim and mute, burn subtitles, video to GIF, convert to MP4, extract audio
Photos: shrink to a size limit, document scanner, palette extractor, format conversion, EXIF stripper
Utilities: QR codes, checksums, JSON formatter, Base64
